text:
IncidentBot: PAGER: Sev2 - elevated SSE disconnects and tool-call parsing errors observed across multiple customers starting 2026-03-14 19:03:20 UTC. Auto-alert threshold hit (error rate > 5% for 5m). Paging on-call.

Raj: acked. I’m oncall, taking initial triage. @Elaine you free to take handoff if this becomes a prolonged RCA? :wave:

Elaine: I can take the RCA after 6m. For now I’ll start gathering logs and customer impact.

Support-bot: Customer impact: 3 customers reported > 10% failed function-call completions. No SLO breaches yet but retries increased. Ticket IDs: #C-1123, #C-1129, #C-1134.

Mike: seeing repeated JS client reconnects from EU region. Rolling 5m error spikes at 19:04-19:09 UTC.

Sophie: quick mitigation idea: enable legacy tool-call parser (compat mode) at the routing layer to accept partial frames, will trade a bit of latency for success rate. Can do a hot toggle.

Raj: do it. Sophie, flip compat mode and monitor. Also open a canary route to route 5% of traffic to the earlier model variant that doesn't use streaming tool-call framing.

Deploy-bot: deploy started by Sophie — feature-toggle:stream_parser_compat -> ON (canary=5%)

Sophie: toggle pushed. Monitoring: error rate dropped from 7.2% -> 1.8% in canary group, overall system dropping to 4.9%. Good signal.

Omar: collecting raw logs for the window. Extracting sse-handshake and parse errors. Sample error lines:
```
2026-03-14T19:04:21.213Z ERROR parser: toolcall_parse failed err="unexpected EOF while parsing JSON" req_id=ff12a3 user_id=org-789 path=/v1/stream
2026-03-14T19:04:21.214Z WARN stream: dropped chunk length=0 conn_id=cn-45-xyz
2026-03-14T19:04:21.215Z INFO conn: keepalive reset from proxy-03
```

Elaine: interesting pattern — many parse failures tied to small zero-length chunks. Could be client libs that split SSE lines differently or an intermediate proxy trimming newlines.

Raj: hypothesis tracker:
- H1: client-side change — new JS SDK version that emits empty frames (likely) 
- H2: edge-proxy (nginx upgrade) trimming trailing whitespace/newline causing parser to see truncated JSON
- H3: runtime parser is stricter after recent internal change (last deploy 2026-03-14 18:50) and is failing previously-tolerated inputs

Mike: I can confirm we released a small parser strictness patch in runtime at 18:50. Patch note: "reject trailing commas and missing newline terminators". Rolling back is an option.

Elaine: next actions:
- (Sophie) keep compat mode on for 15m and watch for regressions
- (Raj) reach out to top impacted customers for SDK versions and request request-ids
- (Omar) collate conn-level logs + proxy logs for 19:00-19:10
- (Mike) prepare rollback patch to relax trailing newline requirement if compat mode insufficient

Support-bot: Outreach: messages sent to #C-1123 and #C-1129 asking for SDK version, device OS, and sample request-id. Awaiting reply.

Sophie: turning canary -> 20% to see broader impact mitigation (will monitor cost).

Deploy-bot: feature-toggle:stream_parser_compat -> ON (canary=20%)

Omar: attaching timeline snippets (excerpt):
```
19:02:57 - client connect sse id=cn-45-xyz
19:04:21 - parse error req_id=ff12a3
19:04:22 - proxy reset proxy-03
19:04:25 - client reconnect
19:05:10 - deploy toggle compat ON (canary)
19:06:00 - error rate starts decreasing
```

Elaine: early findings: correlation across customers + same proxy nodes -> H2 plausible; but presence of parser patch means H3 also likely. Need to repro locally.

Raj: repro steps request: record raw SSE frames from an affected client with curl or tcpdump. Sophie/Omar can we get a minimal repro? If client SDK change, ask customers for version and sample payload.

Mike: I spun up local harness to feed intentionally-split JSON across SSE frames. With strict parser (post-18:50) it fails. With compat parser it succeeds. So H3 is confirmed repro.

Elaine: decision: keep compat mode ON globally for now, roll back strict parser change in runtime, and run a compatibility test suite. We’ll then reintroduce stricter checks once clients are updated. 

Raj: agreed. Mike, coordinate rollback and patch release. Sophie, monitor for any regressions while rollback occurs.

Deploy-bot: runtime rollback initiated by Mike -> rolling back release f2b9c3 -> previous stable f2b90a. Expected 3m.

Mike: rollback completed. Post-rollback metrics: error rate dropped to 0.9% overall. No new customer alerts.

Support-bot: customers notified of mitigation and rollback, will ask for follow-up SDK versions and timeline. Support tickets updated.

Elaine: RCA kickoff notes saved. Follow-ups:
- collect SDK versions and correlate with errors
- add fuzz tests to streaming parser to accept permissive framing
- add metrics for dropped-chunk counts at edge
- create TL;DR for customers

Omar: saving logs bundle to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1865432100/bundle.tar.gz

Elaine: I'm taking lead on the formal RCA doc. Raj will stay on incident coordination. Mike/Sophie/Omar to help with technical writeups. Target 72h for final report, preliminary postmortem tomorrow EOD.

Raj: handing off active coordination to Elaine now. I’m shifting to secondary. Thanks team :heart:

Elaine: taking handoff. I’ll keep this thread updated and will create the postmortem doc link when ready.

IncidentBot: Incident Sev2 -> status: mitigated -> lead: Elaine -> incident_id: INC-20260314-7

Sophie: small nudge: we should ship a patch to the JS SDK to normalize SSE framing; will open PR and link to RCA.

Support-bot: Customer note drafted and sent to affected accounts.

Elaine: Closing on-call coordination in this thread. If anyone adds more logs or findings, append here. Will convert to postmortem in #product-docs once draft ready.
